structured_plan.G: Pending research results. After the trees finish, select among correctly validated candidates using the official wall-clock measurements, integrate only in src/candidate.cpp, and independently confirm the final program on the separate confirmation seeds.
structured_plan.analysis: Choose N=2: the supplied baseline is a valid scalar state-machine decoder, with an automatic mean of 2.5492586202087833e-05 seconds across three samples. No candidate or per-size comparison is available yet. The main complementary opportunities are bulk SIMD decoding and a simpler scalar fast path; both must preserve exact output and work for every valid standard padded input, including short inputs and terminal padding. The timed thread budget is one, so do not add parallel workers. Neither tree should be presumed faster until measured.

children.objective: Explore a single-thread AVX2 bulk decode path in src/candidate.cpp for complete non-padding Base64 blocks, including efficient alphabet mapping and bit packing. Use a safe scalar tail or fallback for remaining groups and terminal padding. Do not overread input or write beyond the exact decoded payload; write the uint64 decoded count at offset 0 and payload at offset 16 without disturbing bytes 8..15. Preserve the run ABI and correctness for every valid input size. Compare official correctness and wall-clock measurements against baseline; retain only measured improvements.
children.subject: AVX2 bulk Base64 decoding

children.objective: Explore a non-SIMD scalar fast path in src/candidate.cpp that decodes independent four-character groups directly, avoiding the stream state machine and unnecessary per-character control flow. Measure table-lookup and/or arithmetic mapping and unrolled group processing. Derive the exact output count from valid padded input and handle the terminal group with bounded writes; do not assume spare output capacity. Preserve the run ABI, output layout, single-thread budget, and correctness for every valid input size. Compare official correctness and wall-clock measurements against baseline; record failed variants as well as improvements.
children.subject: Scalar grouped decode fast path
